rungs.example: Росія, Russia, Індія, India, Україна, Ukraine, Естонія, Estonia, США, USA, China, Польща, Tajikistan, Mongolia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Israel
rungs.foldTest: 'Російська Федерація was involved in an event' -> 'Росія was involved in an event': same claim, less detail

rejected.candidate: USA/США to United States of America
rejected.reason: The transition from 'USA' (abbreviation) or 'Росія' (common name) to a full formal title is not a removal of detail but an addition of it; conversely, the jump from 'Russian Federation' to 'Russia' removes the qualifier 'Federation'.
These are linguistic variations (translations) and do not represent a change in granularity of the entity type.

ladder.notes: The ladder is based on the distinction between formal, qualified state names (e.g., 'Russian Federation') and common-name identifiers. All other countries listed are represented by their common titles and appear at the same level of detail as 'Росія/Russia'.
